items.title: 52193_Jay McShann oral history interview
items.q: I had been down in Texas and had run into [AH] Hibler and had promised Hibler when we leave that we're going to have him join the band.

ctx.x: Yes, and so we come on back, you know, came on back to Kansas City. But in the meantime, I had been down in Texas and had run into [AH] Hibler and had promised Hibler when we leave that we're going to have him join the band. But what had happened, I had sent Hibler

his telegram and his ticket, but his girlfriend would always intercept the ticket -- I mean, intercept the telegram. So Hibler would never get the telegram. So my mother's brother passed, he died. So after he died, I had to go to Oklahoma to the funeral and so I got to thinking, I says, -- no, this fella that knew him called Hibler up. Hibler had left San Anton and went to Fort Worth. He says, "Hibler, McShann's been trying to get in touch with you. Why don't you call him and let him know where you're at?"
